metadata.title: 14 CFR Part 25 - Transport Category Airplane Certification

attributes.attr_text: This part prescribes airworthiness standards for the issuance of type certificates, and changes to those certificates, for transport category airplanes. Applies to: (1) Jets with 10+ seats or MTOW > 12,500 lbs; (2) Propeller aircraft with 19+ seats or MTOW > 19,000 lbs.
attributes.description: This part prescribes airworthiness standards for the issuance of type certificates, and changes to those certificates, for transport category airplanes. Applies to: (1) Jets with 10+ seats or MTOW > 12,500 lbs; (2) Propeller aircraft with 19+ seats or MTOW > 19,000 lbs.

attributes.attr_text: For ETOPS (Extended Operations) beyond 60 minutes from an adequate airport, the applicant must demonstrate the airplane-engine combination is capable of safe flight considering catastrophic single failures and adverse operating conditions.
attributes.description: For ETOPS (Extended Operations) beyond 60 minutes from an adequate airport, the applicant must demonstrate the airplane-engine combination is capable of safe flight considering catastrophic single failures and adverse operating conditions.

attributes.attr_text: Compliance with the flight requirements must be shown by tests upon an airplane of the type for which certification is requested, or by calculations based on test data from similar airplane configurations.
attributes.description: Compliance with the flight requirements must be shown by tests upon an airplane of the type for which certification is requested, or by calculations based on test data from similar airplane configurations.

attributes.attr_text: The airplane must meet takeoff performance requirements including: accelerate-stop distance, takeoff distance, takeoff run, and one-engine-inoperative takeoff flight path. Must account for runway slope, wind, and atmospheric conditions.
attributes.description: The airplane must meet takeoff performance requirements including: accelerate-stop distance, takeoff distance, takeoff run, and one-engine-inoperative takeoff flight path. Must account for runway slope, wind, and atmospheric conditions.

attributes.attr_text: Landing distance must be determined on a level, smooth, dry, hard-surfaced runway. Must demonstrate performance with and without thrust reversers, at maximum landing weight.
attributes.description: Landing distance must be determined on a level, smooth, dry, hard-surfaced runway. Must demonstrate performance with and without thrust reversers, at maximum landing weight.

attributes.attr_text: Reference stall speed V_SR must be determined in 1-g flight using a method that produces minimum speed with wings level. V_S1 and V_SR must be established for each configuration.
attributes.description: Reference stall speed V_SR must be determined in 1-g flight using a method that produces minimum speed with wings level. V_S1 and V_SR must be established for each configuration.

attributes.attr_text: The airplane must be safely controllable and maneuverable during all flight phases including takeoff, climb, cruise, descent, approach, landing, and engine-out conditions. No exceptional piloting skill or strength shall be required.
attributes.description: The airplane must be safely controllable and maneuverable during all flight phases including takeoff, climb, cruise, descent, approach, landing, and engine-out conditions. No exceptional piloting skill or strength shall be required.

attributes.attr_text: The airplane must have adequate directional and lateral control with the critical engine inoperative. V_MC (minimum control speed) must be established and demonstrated.
attributes.description: The airplane must have adequate directional and lateral control with the critical engine inoperative. V_MC (minimum control speed) must be established and demonstrated.

attributes.attr_text: The airplane must exhibit positive static longitudinal stability in all configurations. Stick force gradients must provide natural feel and proper speed stability characteristics.
attributes.description: The airplane must exhibit positive static longitudinal stability in all configurations. Stick force gradients must provide natural feel and proper speed stability characteristics.

attributes.attr_text: The airplane must have adequate stall warning and stall characteristics. During stall entry and recovery, there shall be no uncontrollable pitching, rolling, or yawing. Stall warning must occur at least 5 knots before stall.
attributes.description: The airplane must have adequate stall warning and stall characteristics. During stall entry and recovery, there shall be no uncontrollable pitching, rolling, or yawing. Stall warning must occur at least 5 knots before stall.

attributes.attr_text: Strength requirements are specified in terms of limit loads (maximum loads expected in service) and ultimate loads (limit loads multiplied by prescribed factors of safety, typically 1.5). Structure must withstand limit loads without detrimental permanent deformation.
attributes.description: Strength requirements are specified in terms of limit loads (maximum loads expected in service) and ultimate loads (limit loads multiplied by prescribed factors of safety, typically 1.5). Structure must withstand limit loads without detrimental permanent deformation.

attributes.attr_text: The structure must be designed for symmetric maneuver conditions within the V-n diagram. Positive limit maneuvering load factor of at least 2.5 at V_C and negative load factor capability as specified. Gust loads per continuous turbulence and discrete gust requirements.
attributes.description: The structure must be designed for symmetric maneuver conditions within the V-n diagram. Positive limit maneuvering load factor of at least 2.5 at V_C and negative load factor capability as specified. Gust loads per continuous turbulence and discrete gust requirements.

attributes.attr_text: The structure must protect occupants under emergency landing conditions. Static loads: 9g forward, 1.5g aft, 3g upward, 6g downward, 3g sideward. Dynamic test conditions for seats and restraint systems.
attributes.description: The structure must protect occupants under emergency landing conditions. Static loads: 9g forward, 1.5g aft, 3g upward, 6g downward, 3g sideward. Dynamic test conditions for seats and restraint systems.

attributes.attr_text: An evaluation of the structure must show that catastrophic failure due to fatigue, corrosion, manufacturing defects, or accidental damage will be avoided throughout operational life. Requires inspection programs and retirement times for Principal Structural Elements (PSEs).
attributes.description: An evaluation of the structure must show that catastrophic failure due to fatigue, corrosion, manufacturing defects, or accidental damage will be avoided throughout operational life. Requires inspection programs and retirement times for Principal Structural Elements (PSEs).

attributes.attr_text: The airplane must be protected against catastrophic effects of lightning. Direct and swept lightning attachment points, fuel system protection, and electromagnetic effects on electrical/electronic systems must be addressed.
attributes.description: The airplane must be protected against catastrophic effects of lightning. Direct and swept lightning attachment points, fuel system protection, and electromagnetic effects on electrical/electronic systems must be addressed.

attributes.attr_text: Materials must have design values based on adequate test data and conform to approved specifications. Fabrication methods must produce consistently sound structures with repeatable properties.
attributes.description: Materials must have design values based on adequate test data and conform to approved specifications. Fabrication methods must produce consistently sound structures with repeatable properties.

attributes.attr_text: Flight control systems must operate easily, smoothly, and positively. Must be designed to minimize jamming, chafing, and interference. Redundancy and failure modes analysis required for fly-by-wire systems.
attributes.description: Flight control systems must operate easily, smoothly, and positively. Must be designed to minimize jamming, chafing, and interference. Redundancy and failure modes analysis required for fly-by-wire systems.

attributes.attr_text: Landing gear must be designed for all loading conditions including ground loads, tire failures, and retraction/extension cycles. Position indicating systems, braking systems, and steering systems requirements.
attributes.description: Landing gear must be designed for all loading conditions including ground loads, tire failures, and retraction/extension cycles. Position indicating systems, braking systems, and steering systems requirements.

attributes.attr_text: Passenger and crew doors must have positive locking mechanisms. Emergency exits must be openable from inside and outside, with clear marking. Minimum exit dimensions and distribution requirements for rapid evacuation.
attributes.description: Passenger and crew doors must have positive locking mechanisms. Emergency exits must be openable from inside and outside, with clear marking. Minimum exit dimensions and distribution requirements for rapid evacuation.

attributes.attr_text: Fire zones must have approved fire detection and extinguishing systems. Cabin interior materials must meet flammability requirements (12-second vertical burn test, heat release, smoke density). Cargo compartment fire protection classification.
attributes.description: Fire zones must have approved fire detection and extinguishing systems. Cabin interior materials must meet flammability requirements (12-second vertical burn test, heat release, smoke density). Cargo compartment fire protection classification.

attributes.attr_text: Equipment and systems must be designed to ensure they perform their intended functions under foreseeable operating conditions. Failure analysis required: Catastrophic failures must be extremely improbable (10^-9/FH), Hazardous extremely remote (10^-7/FH), Major remote (10^-5/FH).
attributes.description: Equipment and systems must be designed to ensure they perform their intended functions under foreseeable operating conditions. Failure analysis required: Catastrophic failures must be extremely improbable (10^-9/FH), Hazardous extremely remote (10^-7/FH), Major remote (10^-5/FH).

attributes.attr_text: Electrical and electronic systems that perform functions whose failure would contribute to or cause catastrophic or hazardous failure conditions must be designed and installed to ensure operation in the High Intensity Radiated Fields (HIRF) environment.
attributes.description: Electrical and electronic systems that perform functions whose failure would contribute to or cause catastrophic or hazardous failure conditions must be designed and installed to ensure operation in the High Intensity Radiated Fields (HIRF) environment.

attributes.attr_text: Warning, caution, and advisory alerts must be provided to the flightcrew. Must be prioritized appropriately and designed to minimize flightcrew errors. Red = Warning (immediate action), Amber = Caution (awareness/action), Blue/Green/White = Advisory.
attributes.description: Warning, caution, and advisory alerts must be provided to the flightcrew. Must be prioritized appropriately and designed to minimize flightcrew errors. Red = Warning (immediate action), Amber = Caution (awareness/action), Blue/Green/White = Advisory.

attributes.attr_text: The generating system must supply power for all required electrical equipment with adequate capacity and regulation. Bus architecture, emergency power (RAT/batteries), and electrical load analysis required.
attributes.description: The generating system must supply power for all required electrical equipment with adequate capacity and regulation. Bus architecture, emergency power (RAT/batteries), and electrical load analysis required.

attributes.attr_title: Subpart G - Operating Limitations and Information (25.1501 - 25.1587)
attributes.long_name: Subpart G - Operating Limitations and Information (25.1501 - 25.1587)

attributes.attr_text: Airspeed limitations (V_MO/M_MO, V_A, V_FE, V_LE, V_LO), weight and CG limits, altitude limits, ambient temperature limits, and powerplant limitations must be established and documented in the AFM.
attributes.description: Airspeed limitations (V_MO/M_MO, V_A, V_FE, V_LE, V_LO), weight and CG limits, altitude limits, ambient temperature limits, and powerplant limitations must be established and documented in the AFM.

attributes.attr_text: An AFM must be provided containing: operating limitations, procedures (normal, abnormal, emergency), performance data, and weight/balance information. Must be approved by the FAA and must be available in the airplane.
attributes.description: An AFM must be provided containing: operating limitations, procedures (normal, abnormal, emergency), performance data, and weight/balance information. Must be approved by the FAA and must be available in the airplane.

attributes.attr_title: Subpart H - Electrical Wiring Interconnection Systems (25.1701 - 25.1733)
attributes.long_name: Subpart H - Electrical Wiring Interconnection Systems (25.1701 - 25.1733)

attributes.attr_text: EWIS must be designed and installed to minimize fire hazards and electromagnetic interference. Separation requirements from fuel, hydraulic, and oxygen systems. Wire sizing, protection, and identification requirements. EWIS Instructions for Continued Airworthiness required.
attributes.description: EWIS must be designed and installed to minimize fire hazards and electromagnetic interference. Separation requirements from fuel, hydraulic, and oxygen systems. Wire sizing, protection, and identification requirements. EWIS Instructions for Continued Airworthiness required.

attributes.attr_text: Defines atmospheric icing conditions (continuous maximum and intermittent maximum) for certification. LWC, droplet diameter, temperature ranges. Basis for ice protection system design and testing.
attributes.description: Defines atmospheric icing conditions (continuous maximum and intermittent maximum) for certification. LWC, droplet diameter, temperature ranges. Basis for ice protection system design and testing.

attributes.attr_text: Full-scale emergency evacuation demonstration required. All passengers and crew must evacuate within 90 seconds using half of the available exits. Night lighting conditions, realistic passenger demographics.
attributes.description: Full-scale emergency evacuation demonstration required. All passengers and crew must evacuate within 90 seconds using half of the available exits. Night lighting conditions, realistic passenger demographics.

attributes.attr_text: Extended Operations requirements for twin-engine airplanes. Diversion time up to 180+ minutes from adequate airport. Reliability, propulsion system monitoring, ETOPS maintenance program, and route-specific considerations.
attributes.description: Extended Operations requirements for twin-engine airplanes. Diversion time up to 180+ minutes from adequate airport. Reliability, propulsion system monitoring, ETOPS maintenance program, and route-specific considerations.

attributes.attr_text: Defines SLD icing conditions including freezing drizzle and freezing rain. Required for aircraft seeking certification for flight in SLD conditions. Extended droplet size distributions beyond Appendix C.
attributes.description: Defines SLD icing conditions including freezing drizzle and freezing rain. Required for aircraft seeking certification for flight in SLD conditions. Extended droplet size distributions beyond Appendix C.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1(a): This part prescribes airworthiness standards for the issue of type certificates, and changes to those certificates, for transport category airplanes.
attributes.description: §25.1(a): This part prescribes airworthiness standards for the issue of type certificates, and changes to those certificates, for transport category airplanes.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1(b): Each person who applies under Part 21 for such a certificate or change must show compliance with the applicable requirements in this part.
attributes.description: §25.1(b): Each person who applies under Part 21 for such a certificate or change must show compliance with the applicable requirements in this part.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1: Transport category applies to jets with 10+ seats or MTOW >12,500 lbs, or propeller aircraft with 19+ seats or MTOW >19,000 lbs.
attributes.description: §25.1: Transport category applies to jets with 10+ seats or MTOW >12,500 lbs, or propeller aircraft with 19+ seats or MTOW >19,000 lbs.

attributes.attr_text: §25.3(a): The applicant must demonstrate that the airplane-engine combination is capable of safe extended operations beyond 60 minutes from an adequate airport.
attributes.description: §25.3(a): The applicant must demonstrate that the airplane-engine combination is capable of safe extended operations beyond 60 minutes from an adequate airport.

attributes.attr_text: §25.3(b): ETOPS eligibility requires demonstration of safe flight considering catastrophic single failures and adverse operating conditions.
attributes.description: §25.3(b): ETOPS eligibility requires demonstration of safe flight considering catastrophic single failures and adverse operating conditions.

attributes.attr_text: §25.3(c): The applicant must identify ETOPS-critical systems and establish maintenance requirements for continued airworthiness.
attributes.description: §25.3(c): The applicant must identify ETOPS-critical systems and establish maintenance requirements for continued airworthiness.

attributes.attr_text: §25.21(a): Each requirement must be met at each appropriate combination of weight and center of gravity within the range of loading conditions.
attributes.description: §25.21(a): Each requirement must be met at each appropriate combination of weight and center of gravity within the range of loading conditions.

attributes.attr_text: §25.21(a): Compliance must be shown by tests upon an airplane of the type for which certification is requested, or by calculations based on, and equal in accuracy to, the results of testing.
attributes.description: §25.21(a): Compliance must be shown by tests upon an airplane of the type for which certification is requested, or by calculations based on, and equal in accuracy to, the results of testing.

attributes.attr_text: §25.21(c): Controllability, stability, trim, and stalling characteristics must be shown for each altitude up to the maximum expected in operation.
attributes.description: §25.21(c): Controllability, stability, trim, and stalling characteristics must be shown for each altitude up to the maximum expected in operation.

attributes.attr_text: §25.101(a): Unless otherwise prescribed, airplanes must meet the applicable performance requirements of this subpart for ambient atmospheric conditions and still air.
attributes.description: §25.101(a): Unless otherwise prescribed, airplanes must meet the applicable performance requirements of this subpart for ambient atmospheric conditions and still air.

attributes.attr_text: §25.101(c): Performance must account for the propulsive thrust available under the particular ambient atmospheric conditions, including installation losses and accessory power absorption.
attributes.description: §25.101(c): Performance must account for the propulsive thrust available under the particular ambient atmospheric conditions, including installation losses and accessory power absorption.

attributes.attr_text: §25.101(i): Accelerate-stop and landing distances must be determined with all airplane wheel brake assemblies at the fully worn limit of their allowable wear range.
attributes.description: §25.101(i): Accelerate-stop and landing distances must be determined with all airplane wheel brake assemblies at the fully worn limit of their allowable wear range.

attributes.attr_text: §25.119: In the landing configuration, the steady gradient of climb may not be less than 3.2% for two-engine airplanes with critical engine inoperative.
attributes.description: §25.119: In the landing configuration, the steady gradient of climb may not be less than 3.2% for two-engine airplanes with critical engine inoperative.

attributes.attr_text: §25.125(a): The horizontal distance necessary to land and come to a complete stop from a point 50 feet above the landing surface must be determined.
attributes.description: §25.125(a): The horizontal distance necessary to land and come to a complete stop from a point 50 feet above the landing surface must be determined.

attributes.attr_text: §25.125(b): Landing distances must be determined on a level, smooth, dry, hard-surfaced runway using operational procedures.
attributes.description: §25.125(b): Landing distances must be determined on a level, smooth, dry, hard-surfaced runway using operational procedures.

attributes.attr_text: §25.103(a): The reference stall speed VSR is a calibrated airspeed defined by the applicant as an equivalent airspeed with respect to the 1-g stall speed.
attributes.description: §25.103(a): The reference stall speed VSR is a calibrated airspeed defined by the applicant as an equivalent airspeed with respect to the 1-g stall speed.

attributes.attr_text: §25.103(b): VSR must be determined with zero thrust at the stall speed, or with thrust not exceeding that required for level flight at 1.5VSR.
attributes.description: §25.103(b): VSR must be determined with zero thrust at the stall speed, or with thrust not exceeding that required for level flight at 1.5VSR.

attributes.attr_text: §25.103(c): The stall warning must begin at a speed exceeding the stall speed by a sufficient margin to allow the pilot to prevent stalling.
attributes.description: §25.103(c): The stall warning must begin at a speed exceeding the stall speed by a sufficient margin to allow the pilot to prevent stalling.

attributes.attr_text: §25.143(a): The airplane must be safely controllable and maneuverable during takeoff, climb, level flight, descent, and landing.
attributes.description: §25.143(a): The airplane must be safely controllable and maneuverable during takeoff, climb, level flight, descent, and landing.

attributes.attr_text: §25.143(b): It must be possible to make a smooth transition from one flight condition to any other flight condition without exceptional piloting skill, alertness, or strength.
attributes.description: §25.143(b): It must be possible to make a smooth transition from one flight condition to any other flight condition without exceptional piloting skill, alertness, or strength.

attributes.attr_text: §25.143(d): Control forces may not exceed: Pitch 75 lbs (short term), 10 lbs (long term); Roll 50 lbs (short term), 5 lbs (long term); Yaw 150 lbs (short term), 20 lbs (long term).
attributes.description: §25.143(d): Control forces may not exceed: Pitch 75 lbs (short term), 10 lbs (long term); Roll 50 lbs (short term), 5 lbs (long term); Yaw 150 lbs (short term), 20 lbs (long term).

attributes.attr_text: §25.147(a): For turbopropeller aircraft, takeoff must be possible using normal piloting skill when the critical engine suddenly becomes inoperative.
attributes.description: §25.147(a): For turbopropeller aircraft, takeoff must be possible using normal piloting skill when the critical engine suddenly becomes inoperative.

attributes.attr_text: §25.147(c): For all airplanes, it must be possible to safely make a reasonably sudden change in heading of up to 15 degrees at 1.4VSR1.
attributes.description: §25.147(c): For all airplanes, it must be possible to safely make a reasonably sudden change in heading of up to 15 degrees at 1.4VSR1.

attributes.attr_text: §25.147(e): VMC is the calibrated airspeed at which, when the critical engine is suddenly made inoperative, it is possible to maintain control with a bank of not more than 5 degrees.
attributes.description: §25.147(e): VMC is the calibrated airspeed at which, when the critical engine is suddenly made inoperative, it is possible to maintain control with a bank of not more than 5 degrees.

attributes.attr_text: §25.171: The airplane must be longitudinally, directionally, and laterally stable in accordance with the provisions of §§25.173 through 25.181.
attributes.description: §25.171: The airplane must be longitudinally, directionally, and laterally stable in accordance with the provisions of §§25.173 through 25.181.

attributes.attr_text: §25.173: Static longitudinal stability - the stick force curve must have a stable slope at speeds between 85% and 115% of the trim speed.
attributes.description: §25.173: Static longitudinal stability - the stick force curve must have a stable slope at speeds between 85% and 115% of the trim speed.

attributes.attr_text: §25.181: Dynamic stability - any short-period oscillation must be heavily damped; any combined lateral-directional oscillations must be positively damped.
attributes.description: §25.181: Dynamic stability - any short-period oscillation must be heavily damped; any combined lateral-directional oscillations must be positively damped.

attributes.attr_text: §25.201(a): Stall characteristics must be demonstrated in straight flight and in 30-degree banked turns with power off and at maximum continuous power.
attributes.description: §25.201(a): Stall characteristics must be demonstrated in straight flight and in 30-degree banked turns with power off and at maximum continuous power.

attributes.attr_text: §25.201(b): During the stall tests, it must be possible to prevent more than 15 degrees of roll or yaw by the normal use of the controls.
attributes.description: §25.201(b): During the stall tests, it must be possible to prevent more than 15 degrees of roll or yaw by the normal use of the controls.

attributes.attr_text: §25.201(c): The airplane must give a clear and distinctive stall warning with sufficient margin to prevent inadvertent stalling.
attributes.description: §25.201(c): The airplane must give a clear and distinctive stall warning with sufficient margin to prevent inadvertent stalling.

attributes.attr_text: §25.301(a): Strength requirements are specified in terms of limit loads (maximum loads expected in service) and ultimate loads (limit loads multiplied by prescribed factors of safety).
attributes.description: §25.301(a): Strength requirements are specified in terms of limit loads (maximum loads expected in service) and ultimate loads (limit loads multiplied by prescribed factors of safety).

attributes.attr_text: §25.301(b): Air, ground, and water loads must be placed in equilibrium with inertia forces, considering each item of mass in the airplane.
attributes.description: §25.301(b): Air, ground, and water loads must be placed in equilibrium with inertia forces, considering each item of mass in the airplane.

attributes.attr_text: §25.301(c): If deflections under load significantly change the distribution of external or internal loads, this redistribution must be taken into account.
attributes.description: §25.301(c): If deflections under load significantly change the distribution of external or internal loads, this redistribution must be taken into account.

attributes.attr_text: §25.303: Unless otherwise specified, a factor of safety of 1.5 must be applied to the prescribed limit load which are considered external loads on the structure.
attributes.description: §25.303: Unless otherwise specified, a factor of safety of 1.5 must be applied to the prescribed limit load which are considered external loads on the structure.

attributes.attr_text: §25.305(a): The structure must be able to support limit loads without detrimental permanent deformation.
attributes.description: §25.305(a): The structure must be able to support limit loads without detrimental permanent deformation.

attributes.attr_text: §25.305(b): The structure must be able to support ultimate loads without failure for at least 3 seconds.
attributes.description: §25.305(b): The structure must be able to support ultimate loads without failure for at least 3 seconds.

attributes.attr_text: §25.571(a): An evaluation must be conducted to show that catastrophic failure due to fatigue, corrosion, manufacturing defects, or accidental damage will be avoided throughout the operational life.
attributes.description: §25.571(a): An evaluation must be conducted to show that catastrophic failure due to fatigue, corrosion, manufacturing defects, or accidental damage will be avoided throughout the operational life.

attributes.attr_text: §25.571(b): Damage-tolerance evaluation must include a determination of probable locations and modes of damage, and inspection thresholds and intervals.
attributes.description: §25.571(b): Damage-tolerance evaluation must include a determination of probable locations and modes of damage, and inspection thresholds and intervals.

attributes.attr_text: §25.571(b): A limit of validity (LOV) of the engineering data that supports the structural maintenance program must be established.
attributes.description: §25.571(b): A limit of validity (LOV) of the engineering data that supports the structural maintenance program must be established.

attributes.attr_text: §25.581(a): The airplane must be protected against catastrophic effects from lightning.
attributes.description: §25.581(a): The airplane must be protected against catastrophic effects from lightning.

attributes.attr_text: §25.581(b): For metallic components, acceptable methods of protection include bonding and grounding to disperse lightning currents.
attributes.description: §25.581(b): For metallic components, acceptable methods of protection include bonding and grounding to disperse lightning currents.

attributes.attr_text: §25.581(c): For non-metallic components, acceptable methods include installation of conductive materials to provide lightning current paths.
attributes.description: §25.581(c): For non-metallic components, acceptable methods include installation of conductive materials to provide lightning current paths.

attributes.attr_text: §25.631(a): The empennage structure must be designed to assure capability of continued safe flight and landing after impact with a 4-pound bird at VC.
attributes.description: §25.631(a): The empennage structure must be designed to assure capability of continued safe flight and landing after impact with a 4-pound bird at VC.

attributes.attr_text: §25.631(b): The airplane must be capable of successfully completing the flight after impact with a 4-pound bird when damage locations are in accordance with the requirements.
attributes.description: §25.631(b): The airplane must be capable of successfully completing the flight after impact with a 4-pound bird when damage locations are in accordance with the requirements.

attributes.attr_text: §25.775: Windshields and windows must be made of material that will not break into dangerous fragments when subjected to a 4-pound bird impact at VC.
attributes.description: §25.775: Windshields and windows must be made of material that will not break into dangerous fragments when subjected to a 4-pound bird impact at VC.

attributes.attr_text: §25.603(a): The suitability and durability of materials used for parts, the failure of which could adversely affect safety, must be established on the basis of experience or tests.
attributes.description: §25.603(a): The suitability and durability of materials used for parts, the failure of which could adversely affect safety, must be established on the basis of experience or tests.

attributes.attr_text: §25.603(b): Materials must conform to approved specifications that ensure their having the strength and other properties assumed in the design data.
attributes.description: §25.603(b): Materials must conform to approved specifications that ensure their having the strength and other properties assumed in the design data.

attributes.attr_text: §25.605: Fabrication methods must produce consistently sound structure. Special processes must be performed under approved process specifications.
attributes.description: §25.605: Fabrication methods must produce consistently sound structure. Special processes must be performed under approved process specifications.

attributes.attr_text: §25.671(a): Each control system must operate with the ease, smoothness, and positiveness appropriate to its function.
attributes.description: §25.671(a): Each control system must operate with the ease, smoothness, and positiveness appropriate to its function.

attributes.attr_text: §25.671(c): The airplane must be shown by analysis, test, or both, to be capable of continued safe flight and landing after any single failure in the flight control system.
attributes.description: §25.671(c): The airplane must be shown by analysis, test, or both, to be capable of continued safe flight and landing after any single failure in the flight control system.

attributes.attr_text: §25.671(d): All failures not shown to be extremely improbable must be considered, including jamming, disconnection, unintended engagement, or runaway.
attributes.description: §25.671(d): All failures not shown to be extremely improbable must be considered, including jamming, disconnection, unintended engagement, or runaway.

attributes.attr_text: §25.721: The landing gear system must be designed so that when it fails due to overloads during takeoff and landing, the failure mode is not likely to cause spillage of enough fuel to constitute a fire hazard.
attributes.description: §25.721: The landing gear system must be designed so that when it fails due to overloads during takeoff and landing, the failure mode is not likely to cause spillage of enough fuel to constitute a fire hazard.

attributes.attr_text: §25.729(a): The landing gear retracting mechanism must be designed so that the landing gear can be extended in case of failure of the normal landing gear operating mechanism.
attributes.description: §25.729(a): The landing gear retracting mechanism must be designed so that the landing gear can be extended in case of failure of the normal landing gear operating mechanism.

attributes.attr_text: §25.735: Brakes must be designed to prevent hazardous accumulation of heat; the brake temperature must be within operating limits after rejected takeoff at maximum energy.
attributes.description: §25.735: Brakes must be designed to prevent hazardous accumulation of heat; the brake temperature must be within operating limits after rejected takeoff at maximum energy.

attributes.attr_text: §25.801(a): If certification with ditching provisions is requested, the airplane must meet the requirements of this section and §§25.807(e), 25.1411, and 25.1415(a).
attributes.description: §25.801(a): If certification with ditching provisions is requested, the airplane must meet the requirements of this section and §§25.807(e), 25.1411, and 25.1415(a).

attributes.attr_text: §25.801(b): Each practicable design measure must be taken to minimize the probability that in an emergency landing on water, the behavior of the airplane would cause immediate injury to the occupants.
attributes.description: §25.801(b): Each practicable design measure must be taken to minimize the probability that in an emergency landing on water, the behavior of the airplane would cause immediate injury to the occupants.

attributes.attr_text: §25.807: Emergency exits must be distributed as uniformly as practical, and the number and types must meet the requirements for maximum seating capacity.
attributes.description: §25.807: Emergency exits must be distributed as uniformly as practical, and the number and types must meet the requirements for maximum seating capacity.

attributes.attr_text: §25.853(a): Each compartment occupied by the crew or passengers must meet the flammability requirements of Appendix F or other approved equivalent.
attributes.description: §25.853(a): Each compartment occupied by the crew or passengers must meet the flammability requirements of Appendix F or other approved equivalent.

attributes.attr_text: §25.853(d): Each compartment must have a means to allow smoke to be dissipated to prevent obscuration of visibility to the extent necessary for the flight crew to perform their duties.
attributes.description: §25.853(d): Each compartment must have a means to allow smoke to be dissipated to prevent obscuration of visibility to the extent necessary for the flight crew to perform their duties.

attributes.attr_text: §25.855: Each cargo or baggage compartment must be classified according to means of detecting and suppressing fire.
attributes.description: §25.855: Each cargo or baggage compartment must be classified according to means of detecting and suppressing fire.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1301(a): Each item of installed equipment must be of a kind and design appropriate to its intended function.
attributes.description: §25.1301(a): Each item of installed equipment must be of a kind and design appropriate to its intended function.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1301(b): Each item of installed equipment must be labeled as to its identification, function, or operating limitations.
attributes.description: §25.1301(b): Each item of installed equipment must be labeled as to its identification, function, or operating limitations.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1301(c): Each item of installed equipment must be installed according to limitations specified for that equipment.
attributes.description: §25.1301(c): Each item of installed equipment must be installed according to limitations specified for that equipment.

attributes.description: Appendix D: Criteria for demonstration of the emergency evacuation procedures specified in §25.803 are established.

attributes.description: §25.905(b): Engine power and propeller shaft rotational speed may not exceed the limits for which the propeller is certificated.

attributes.description: Each fuel system must be constructed and arranged to ensure a flow of fuel at a rate and pressure established for proper engine and auxiliary power unit functioning under each likely operating condition.

attributes.description: §25.951(a): Each fuel system must be constructed and arranged to ensure fuel flow at a rate and pressure established for proper engine functioning under each likely operating condition.

attributes.description: §25.951(b): Each fuel system must be arranged so that no air introduced into the system will result in flameout for turbine engines or power interruption for more than 20 seconds for reciprocating engines.

attributes.description: §25.951(c): Each turbine engine fuel system must be capable of sustained operation with fuel initially saturated with water at 80°F and cooled to the most critical icing condition.

attributes.description: Each fuel tank must be able to withstand the applicable pressure tests without failure or leakage. Each fuel tank must have adequate structural strength to withstand applicable loads.

attributes.description: §25.963(a): Each fuel tank must be able to withstand, without failure, the vibration, inertia, fluid, and structural loads to which it may be subjected in operation.

attributes.description: §25.963(d): Each fuel tank must be isolated from personnel compartments by fume-proof and fuel-proof enclosures.

attributes.description: §25.981(b): Except as provided, no component whose failure could cause an ignition source may be installed in a fuel tank unless proven to not create a hazard under failure conditions.

attributes.description: §25.1013(c): Each oil tank must provide an oil filler that is accessible, marked with contents, and has a closure that prevents loss of oil.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1183(a): Flammable fluid tanks and supports in designated fire zones must be fireproof or enclosed by a fireproof shield.
attributes.description: §25.1183(a): Flammable fluid tanks and supports in designated fire zones must be fireproof or enclosed by a fireproof shield.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1183(c): All components in designated fire zones must be fireproof if their exposure to fire could cause fire spreading to other airplane regions.
attributes.description: §25.1183(c): All components in designated fire zones must be fireproof if their exposure to fire could cause fire spreading to other airplane regions.

attributes.attr_text: Each engine, auxiliary power unit, fuel-burning heater, and combustion equipment must be isolated from the rest of the airplane by firewalls, shrouds, or equivalent means.
attributes.description: Each engine, auxiliary power unit, fuel-burning heater, and combustion equipment must be isolated from the rest of the airplane by firewalls, shrouds, or equivalent means.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1191(a): Each engine and auxiliary power unit must be isolated from the rest of the airplane by firewalls, shrouds, or equivalent means.
attributes.description: §25.1191(a): Each engine and auxiliary power unit must be isolated from the rest of the airplane by firewalls, shrouds, or equivalent means.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1191(b)(1): Each firewall and shroud must be fireproof.
attributes.description: §25.1191(b)(1): Each firewall and shroud must be fireproof.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1191(b)(2): Each firewall must be constructed so that no hazardous quantity of air, fluid, or flame can pass from the compartment to other parts of the airplane.
attributes.description: §25.1191(b)(2): Each firewall must be constructed so that no hazardous quantity of air, fluid, or flame can pass from the compartment to other parts of the airplane.

attributes.attr_text: Each designated fire zone must have a fire extinguisher system, except for certain turbine engine sections. Agent quantity, discharge rate, and distribution must adequately extinguish fires.
attributes.description: Each designated fire zone must have a fire extinguisher system, except for certain turbine engine sections. Agent quantity, discharge rate, and distribution must adequately extinguish fires.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1195(a): Except for combustor, turbine, and tail pipe sections of turbine engines, each designated fire zone must have a fire extinguisher system.
attributes.description: §25.1195(a): Except for combustor, turbine, and tail pipe sections of turbine engines, each designated fire zone must have a fire extinguisher system.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1195(b): The fire extinguishing system, agent quantity, rate of discharge, and distribution must be adequate to extinguish fires.
attributes.description: §25.1195(b): The fire extinguishing system, agent quantity, rate of discharge, and distribution must be adequate to extinguish fires.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1195(b): Other than for APUs and heaters, each fire zone must have two discharges producing adequate agent concentration.
attributes.description: §25.1195(b): Other than for APUs and heaters, each fire zone must have two discharges producing adequate agent concentration.

attributes.attr_text: Fire extinguishing agents must be capable of extinguishing flames from burning fluids in the protected area and have thermal stability over the temperature range experienced in storage compartments.
attributes.description: Fire extinguishing agents must be capable of extinguishing flames from burning fluids in the protected area and have thermal stability over the temperature range experienced in storage compartments.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1197(a): Fire extinguishing agents must be capable of extinguishing flames emanating from any burning of fluids or combustible materials in the area protected.
attributes.description: §25.1197(a): Fire extinguishing agents must be capable of extinguishing flames emanating from any burning of fluids or combustible materials in the area protected.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1197(a): Fire extinguishing agents must have thermal stability over the temperature range likely to be experienced in the storage compartment.
attributes.description: §25.1197(a): Fire extinguishing agents must have thermal stability over the temperature range likely to be experienced in the storage compartment.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1197(b): If toxic extinguishing agents are used, there must be means to prevent harmful concentrations from entering personnel compartments.
attributes.description: §25.1197(b): If toxic extinguishing agents are used, there must be means to prevent harmful concentrations from entering personnel compartments.

attributes.attr_text: Fire or overheat detectors must be installed in designated fire zones and turbine engine compartment sections to ensure prompt detection of fire.
attributes.description: Fire or overheat detectors must be installed in designated fire zones and turbine engine compartment sections to ensure prompt detection of fire.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1203(a): Fire or overheat detectors must be provided for each designated fire zone and installed to ensure prompt detection of fire.
attributes.description: §25.1203(a): Fire or overheat detectors must be provided for each designated fire zone and installed to ensure prompt detection of fire.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1203(b): Each fire detector system must warn the crew if a sensor or wiring is severed at any point, unless system continues to function.
attributes.description: §25.1203(b): Each fire detector system must warn the crew if a sensor or wiring is severed at any point, unless system continues to function.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1203(c): No fire or overheat detector may be affected by any oil, water, other fluids or fumes that might be present.
attributes.description: §25.1203(c): No fire or overheat detector may be affected by any oil, water, other fluids or fumes that might be present.

attributes.attr_text: §25.1203(e): Components of each fire detector system in a fire zone must be fire-resistant.
attributes.description: §25.1203(e): Components of each fire detector system in a fire zone must be fire-resistant.

attributes.attr_text: The system shall achieve a drop accuracy within a 10 ft by 10 ft target zone during the dive maneuver.
attributes.description: The system shall achieve a drop accuracy within a 10 ft by 10 ft target zone during the dive maneuver.

attributes.attr_text: The aircraft wingspan shall be greater than or equal to 3 feet.
attributes.description: The aircraft wingspan shall be greater than or equal to 3 feet.

attributes.attr_text: The propulsion battery pack weight shall be no more than 1 lb. NOTE: This drives the BIOVIA battery density optimization.
attributes.description: The propulsion battery pack weight shall be no more than 1 lb. NOTE: This drives the BIOVIA battery density optimization.

attributes.attr_text: The AIDA Interface shall process natural language pilot commands with a latency of less than 500ms to ensure safety at cruise speeds of 73.5 ft/s.
attributes.description: The AIDA Interface shall process natural language pilot commands with a latency of less than 500ms to ensure safety at cruise speeds of 73.5 ft/s.

attributes.attr_text: The system shall implement a deterministic "Safety Layer" that overrides AI commands if the load factor exceeds 3.8g.
attributes.description: The system shall implement a deterministic "Safety Layer" that overrides AI commands if the load factor exceeds 3.8g.
